detail.longDescription: Deep in the etymology rabbit hole today while fine-tuning a bilingual vocabulary mapping pipeline. It's fascinating how tracing root words across historical shifts mirrors refactoring an old codebase—you strip away centuries of linguistic debt to find the core semantics beneath. Building lightweight, self-hosted tools that respect performance and data ownership always beats fighting bloated cloud dependencies. # IndieDev # Etymology # Linguistics # OpenSource # SelfHosted
